title: Scrolling captures that keep going, no more flashes, a lighter editor.
notes: Scrolling capture no longer stops after one scroll on a page with a video or an animation on it: frames are lined up by where most of the page agrees, and each scroll is given time to come to rest.
Mac: the screen no longer flashes when a capture or a color pick starts or ends (a black frame as it began, Rega's window over the whole screen for a moment as it ended).
A mark drawn, placed, typed or moved past the edge of the picture now gets canvas under it, as pasted pictures did. (Blur, fill, magnifier and spotlight don't: they need picture to work on.)
Select all (⌘A / Ctrl+A) lets go of the selected mark and picks the whole picture, so Copy takes all of it.
Faster and lighter on large images: the picture is redrawn two to three times faster after a blur, fill or magnifier changes, and the undo history no longer grows without limit on long captures.
